name: Criminal profile
summary: ||Each lead has a Criminal Profile with five tiers, from Professional to Irredeemable, that tracks how much violence you use.||
body: ||OutputLag says the five tiers are Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable, and that you can move up and down the first four.||
||PC Gamer says the profile depends almost entirely on how often you kill, and that Irredeemable is permanent once you reach it.||
||OutputLag says the profile changes how you earn Focus. It says that at Psycho and above you cannot surrender and police open fire sooner.||
||OutputLag says Jason and Lucia each have their own profile, shown on the Jason & Lucia tab of the map.||
||PC Gamer quotes Rockstar saying being irredeemable will have a lasting impact on Jason and Lucia. PC Gamer says it does not yet know what that means.||

name: Cash, the bank and loot
summary: ||Pocket cash is lost when you are wasted or busted, banked money in BuckMe is safe, and loot is worth nothing until a fence buys it.||
body: ||GTABase says you lose all the cash you carry when you are wasted or busted, plus a small BuckMe fee, while money in the bank is safe.||
||PC Gamer says the Chapter 1 mission Buck Me opens a bank account, and that you deposit cash at ATMs.||
||GTABase says you cannot withdraw money through your phone. It says the checking account has a limit that rises as you hit Family Savings goals.||
||PC Gamer says money moved into the joint savings account cannot be taken out again.||
||GTABase says narcotics, jewelry and marked bills in your stash bag have no cash value until a fence takes them.||

name: Fences and laundering
summary: ||Goods fences buy stolen narcotics, jewelry and marked bills at different rates, while Moses and Randy buy cars.||
body: ||GTABase says there are seven fences: five buy stolen goods and two buy cars.||
||GamesRadar+ says goods fences pay different rates, from Very Low to Very High, for narcotics, jewelry and marked bills. It says some pay into your mailbox days later.||
||PC Gamer says Moses buys only older, low-end cars and Randy buys certain expensive cars. It says the Waink It app tells you which car suits each.||
||PC Gamer says your partner can sell goods for you for a little less money. It says that after two Payday Loan jobs for Yasmani you can leave goods at a garage for a fee.||
||GTABase says no passive-income businesses have turned up in GTA 6.||

name: What you can carry
summary: ||You carry two handguns and two long guns. The rest stays in your personal vehicle's trunk or an Ammu-Nation weapon locker.||
body: ||GTABase says your loadout holds two sidearms and two long guns, plus explosives, a melee weapon and equipment such as binoculars.||
||OutputLag says one long gun slings on your back, and a second has to be carried in your hands.||
||PC Gamer says handguns can be concealed but long guns are visible, and people and police react to them.||
||OutputLag says guns you buy can always be recovered from a locker or your trunk. It says guns you pick up are lost when you die or are busted.||
||GamesRadar+ says you can hand one of your weapons to your partner during a robbery.||

name: Focus
summary: Focus slows a fight down and picks out weak points: aim at a red area for a lethal shot, a yellow one to incapacitate.
body: TGG stresses that you still aim and fire yourself; it does not mark targets and shoot for you. Hit markers then tell you the result: white for a hit, yellow for incapacitated, red for a kill.

Out of combat, Focus highlights useful objects, doors you can use and loot. From a vehicle it lets you target the driver, tires, engine block or fuel tank. Nelson told TGG it is also how you see police through walls, since they are not on the minimap.
IGN says Focus is triggered by clicking both sticks together and works the same for Jason and Lucia; it slows time and does not drain the meter unless the player aims or shoots, even while driving.
IGN says Focus lasts 30 seconds on foot with a two-second cooldown once the full 30 seconds are used, and 30 seconds in a vehicle, falling to as little as 10 seconds at very high speed.

IGN gives the colour code as white for things of interest such as doors and consumables, red for enemies, explosives, alarms and dropped weapons, purple for drugs that can be sold to a fence, and green for cash; police glow blue while driving.

IGN says aiming in Focus (Combat Focus) drains the meter and shows yellow spots that wound or disarm and red spots on the head and heart that kill; vehicles show tyre and engine spots and helicopters engine and rotor spots.
IGN says smoking a cigarette refills the meter out of combat, incapacitations refill it with a Professional Criminal Profile and headshots with Violent or worse.

IGN says Focus shows sound ripples leading to nearby events, side missions, searching police units, K9 dogs, helicopters and witnesses, and reveals trails of fleeing vehicles and named animal scent trails, which can be tracked after leaving Focus.

name: Fighting and movement
summary: TGG reports that crouching is back, with strafing while crouched, along with shoulder switching and a cover system.
body: Hand-to-hand fights involve blocking, dodging and grappling. TGG relays other previews that you can hold a block or time a parry, and that Lucia fights more like a kickboxer while Jason is a street brawler.
Automatic weapons kick hard enough that Nelson fired in short bursts in the demo, and pistols fire faster than in Grand Theft Auto V. A bad fall can leave your character dazed for a moment.
Kill cams and a crash camera can each be switched off. Nelson mentioned to TGG that many people who worked on Max Payne 3 are on this game.

IGN says hit markers are white for a hit, yellow for an incapacitated target and red for a kill, and that enemies knocked out non-lethally stay down, though allies who find them become more cautious and bodies can be moved out of sight.
IGN says clicking the right stick while aiming toggles a scope view, Left on the D-pad swaps shoulders, Triangle (Y) swaps weapons while aiming, and R2/RT grabs and then throws an enemy in melee.
IGN says attack dogs can be scared off without hurting them by firing at the ground beside them, and that many compounds can be entered from the roof through hatches.

name: Reported controls
summary: ||GTABase and OutputLag have published the full control layout. Sprint is a click of the left stick and cover is R1.||
body: ||GTABase says GTA 6 drops tap-to-sprint: you click L3 to run, and the Classic scheme swaps Run and Crouch.||
||OutputLag says cover is R1 (RB on Xbox), and switching characters is holding right on the d-pad and then pressing R1.||
||GTABase says the handbrake is X (A on Xbox). It says that while driving you press L1 to draw your sidearm and R1 to fire.||
||OutputLag says a Movement Speed setting lets a full stick push jog instead of walk.||

name: Garages and personal vehicles
summary: ||Garages are the only property you can buy: eight through the Vice City Real Estate app, plus four the story gives you.||
body: ||GTABase says there are 12 garages in the base game, 8 bought with cash and 4 given by the story, and most hold a single car.||
||GTABase says the Vice City Real Estate app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. It says the 8 garages cost $160,000 together.||
||Kotaku says the Scooter Bros app manages your vehicles, brings them to you, repairs them and gets them out of the impound lot, for a fee.||
||GTABase says your registered personal vehicle can always be recovered. It says you can hold Square (X on Xbox) to clear out the trunk of a car you do not own.||

name: Driving and handling
summary: ||Every car handles differently, crashes hurt steering and speed, and each mod shop specializes in a type of vehicle.||
body: ||PC Gamer says the handling, acceleration and physics of every car are different.||
||Kotaku's review says streets are narrower than in GTA V, and crashes can damage your car enough to affect steering and acceleration.||
||OutputLag says R2 is pressure sensitive, so in rear-wheel-drive muscle cars you must feather it or the back end swings out.||
||GamesRadar+ says you can switch to the passenger during a police chase, and tell a partner who is driving to speed up or slow down.||
||GTABase says the map shows the mod shop that specializes in your current vehicle type.||

name: Fuel and public transport
summary: ||Cars use fuel and gas stations also repair them, while taxis, RydeMe, buses and trains move you around.||
body: ||PC Gamer says you refuel from a pump's Services menu, rarely need to, and can pick Repair from the same menu.||
||PC Gamer says electric cars charge at charging stations on the map, which show the cost first.||
||GTABase says Paradise Taxi and the RydeMe app can take you most places a car can reach, and skipping the ride costs an extra $100.||
||Kotaku's review says buses and trains work, with schedules and passengers.||

name: Chapters and story length
summary: ||The story runs across five chapters, has multiple endings, and takes about 50 to 80 hours.||
body: ||OutputLag says the story has five chapters, with 22, 7, 24, 25 and 8 main missions.||
||Kotaku's review says there are multiple endings, and choices can have a huge impact on how things turn out.||
||OutputLag says Rob Nelson's 80-hour figure covered the story plus some optional goals. It says story-only runs take about 50 to 60 hours.||
||VGC says the main campaign is around 60 hours. PowerPyx says its story run took 70 hours with optional quests.||
||Kotaku's review says one mission let it escape in any car, and another adapted when it chased a boat by speedboat instead of dirt bike.||

name: Jason and Lucia's relationship
summary: ||Jason and Lucia's relationship has four levels, from Running on Empty to Hot Together, and it rises or falls with how you treat each other.||
body: ||GTABase says the four levels are Hot Together, Crazy in Love, Not So Hot and Running on Empty.||
||GTABase says the relationship does not affect their criminal partnership, but you need Hot Together for the good endings.||
||PC Gamer says kisses, going out, joint activities and buying each other clothes raise the score. It says both leads need to show affection.||
||GTABase says ignoring calls and messages, or abandoning your partner while traveling, hurts the relationship.||
||GamesRadar+ says you can call your partner or ask them to meet you wherever you are.||

name: Food, sleep and the gym
summary: ||Each lead trains Strength, Cardio and Focus separately, and food and sleep give short boosts and reset training.||
body: ||OutputLag says Strength raises maximum health, Cardio raises maximum stamina and Focus sets how long slow motion lasts. It says each lead trains separately.||
||OutputLag says Jason's deck has a free home gym, while paid gyms sell memberships at the front desk.||
||OutputLag says three of the four deck exercises reach the day's Strength limit, and sleeping resets it.||
||Kotaku says food and drink buff health, stamina and Focus. OutputLag says coffee and energy drinks push Focus and stamina above normal for a while.||
||OutputLag says body weight changes with what a lead eats, but it found no weight number in the stats screens.||

name: Safehouses
summary: ||Safehouses cannot be bought. Jason and Lucia move into a new home as the story moves through its chapters.||
body: ||GTABase says safehouses unlock with the story and garages are the only property you can buy.||
||OutputLag says the homes are Jason's house in Key Lento, the Starlet Motel, an apartment in Bayside, a suite at the Y in Ocean Beach and Giorgio Gallo's penthouse.||
||OutputLag says sleeping moves time on and refills health and Focus. PC Gamer describes showering and watching TV at home.||
||Kotaku says barbers and shops have exclusive styles, and the bathroom mirror at home only trims your hair.||

name: Phone apps
summary: ||The phone holds WAiNK, RydeMe, BuckMe, WhatUp, Snapmatic, Scooter Bros and a fitness app, and more apps unlock with the story.||
body: ||GTABase says WAiNK scans cars, RydeMe books rides, BuckMe is the bank and a fitness app tracks your workouts.||
||GTABase says WhatUp is for keeping in touch, and Snapmatic and a news app follow events around Leonida.||
||Kotaku says the Scooter Bros app brings your vehicles to you.||
||OutputLag says Snapmatic lets you browse and like posts, but Jason and Lucia cannot post their own photos.||
||OutputLag says a Phone Display setting can show the phone in first person.||

name: HUD, photo and streamer options
summary: ||On first launch you pick a navigation style, and the pause menu has a Photo Studio photo mode.||
body: ||VGC says the first choice in GTA 6 is a navigation style: a minimap that appears when needed, the same with a compass, or one that is always on.||
||OutputLag says the photo mode is called Photo Studio, and there is no Rockstar Editor for video at launch.||
||OutputLag says the Audio settings have a Mute Licensed Music option for streaming.||
||OutputLag says police do not appear on your minimap.||

name: Weather and storms
summary: ||Storms roll in across the map, and PowerPyx says a side mission unlocks hurricane weather.||
body: ||Kotaku's review describes dark clouds and lightning forming in the distance, and a lightning bolt starting a small fire.||
||PowerPyx says a hurricane starts during Freddie's side mission Retest Freddie's Defenses, and finishing it unlocks hurricane weather.||
||Cultured Vultures says hair reacts to the weather.||
||OutputLag says Photo Studio cannot change the weather or time of day.||
